chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ismail ibn Abi Sara, who said: Aban ibn Taghlib informed me, saying: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
At what time did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pray Al-Witr? He said: At the time like the setting of the sun, up to the time of the Maghrib prayer.

key_terms.يُوتِرُ: To pray Witr (the optional odd-numbered prayer)

ai.seo_question: When did the Prophet Muhammad pray the Witr prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the specific temporal window for the Witr prayer, identifying it as the period between sunset (ghurub) and the Maghrib prayer. In Shia jurisprudence, this distinction is significant as it differentiates the Prophet's practice from later interpretations that might conflate Witr with Isha or extend it into the night, thereby anchoring the optional prayer within the early evening hours.
